name: public-read-only
description: View Public brokerage account information, check market data for equities, bonds, options, and prediction markets, and run trade preflight checks.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Public account to view information about your brokerage accounts, check market data for equities, bonds, options, and prediction markets, and preview potential trades with preflight checks. Public helps you review account information and market data in conversation and run preflight checks before deciding whether to trade. Requires a Public account and secure OAuth sign-in. This plugin uses Public's read-only MCP endpoint; trade execution is not included.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my Public brokerage account information and help me check market data.
